kept.heading: US COURT RULES GOOGLE WILL NOT HAVE TO SELL AD EXCHANGE AFTER LOSING ANTITRUST CASE (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Google's ad tech dominance will largely remain intact despite the DOJ proving that it illegally restricted competition in parts of the online ad market. The court rejected the government's push to force Google to sell its ad exchange, avoiding a remedy that could have disrupted its broader advertising business. Google will likely face fines and business practice changes, but the exact penalties remain sealed for now. The outcome shows that even after three major antitrust losses, Google retains substantial control over digital advertising and can continue investing aggressively in emerging markets such as AI.

kept.heading: ‘A CRISIS OF AUTHENTICITY': THE TRUTH ABOUT FOOD INFLUENCERS (18 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Positive coverage in food influencing is less a preference than an economic default, since restaurants that stop offering free meals or payment quickly see coverage dry up. That system still drives real reach, with Instagram Reels revenue growing from about $2 billion in 2022 to a projected $50 billion and roughly half of Instagram's time now spent on them. Most restaurant influencers still don't get paid well, with typical per-post rates staying in the low hundreds to low thousands and Instagram not paying for views at all. Viewers have noticed the pattern, and experts predict today's relentlessly positive accounts will lose ground to more critical voices.

kept.heading: WIN REPORT: HOW SUPPLY-SIDE CRO LIFTED SIGN-UPS BY 15% (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Supply-side CRO can unlock major marketplace growth by optimizing for the actual intent of people who provide capacity, not just the customers who buy. A tutoring marketplace found that many tutor recruitment visitors came from job search sites, so it replaced a generic registration form with a real student job request, clear job details, pay information, and “apply” language. The change increased tutor applications by 15%, or about 20,000 additional tutors in the first year. Supply-side improvements may not show immediate revenue, but they can strengthen marketplace capacity and create an overlooked source of high-impact conversion gains.

kept.heading: THE IMPACT OF CONTENT FRESHNESS ON AI CITATIONS (9 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Content cited by AI assistants runs 25.7% fresher than what ranks organically on Google, with roughly half of all citations tracing to material updated in the last 13 weeks. That edge decays fast, with a median citation half-life of about 4.5 weeks across platforms. Retrieval systems re-rank the entire candidate pool on every query rather than relying on a persistent ranking, so recency becomes an early filter for weeding out sources that might already be wrong. Perplexity and Grok weigh it most heavily, while Google's AI Overviews stay tied to core search and actually skew slightly older.

kept.heading: CAPTURE ATTENTION THAT LASTS WITH 15-SECOND ENGAGED VIDEO VIEWS (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Reddit launched a 15-second Engaged Video Views goal that optimizes video ads toward users likely to watch for at least 15 seconds or to completion. It's designed for longer-form creative such as product demos and testimonials, with advertisers paying only for qualifying views. Alpha testers saw average gains of 51% in 15-second view-through rate and 71% in completion rate. The feature is now available globally in public beta, with split testing available to compare it against 6-second views.

kept.heading: BUILD VS. BUY: MARKETING TOOLS IN THE VIBE CODE ERA (6 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: AI is changing how marketing teams should think about build vs. buy. Teams should build when customization or proprietary data creates an advantage, and buy when vendors handle complex infrastructure that's expensive to maintain. They also warn against letting vibe-coded tools become one-off projects that only one person uses. When evaluating software, ask what would break if you canceled it and whether you're buying the product or simply a way to organize data you already own.

kept.heading: CREATORS AS A SALES ENGINE: HOW CHINA IS RETHINKING THE ENTIRE CUSTOMER JOURNEY (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: China is showing how creators are becoming part of the sales infrastructure, not just a communications channel. On platforms like Rednote, creator content can intercept search, shape product research, trigger retargeting, and drive purchases through livestreams and in-platform ecommerce. The result is a more connected customer journey where content, search, community, and commerce work together rather than as separate channels. As platforms like TikTok expand into commerce, this model offers a preview of how social could take on more of the customer journey in Western markets.

kept.heading: STICKI ROLLS IS TURNING STICKERS INTO THE NEW SOCIAL CURRENCY (4 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Sticki Rolls turns stickers into social currency by designing the product around sharing and self-expression. It has expanded into bracelets, sticker books, pendants, and bag charms that fans can collect and show off. The brand also works with creators who shaped its original collections and uses unexpected spaces like nail salons to bring the product into beauty and fashion. Its pop-ups further turn fans into participants, with activities like sticker manicures and BFF bracelet-making.

kept.heading: SKIMS MARKETING STRATEGY: KIM KARDASHIAN'S BILLION-DOLLAR BRAND (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Behind SKIMS' celebrity headlines is a disciplined owned-channel operation, with the brand sending roughly five emails a week announcing drops, restocks, and retail collaborations. Before a major collection ships, SKIMS also seeds unboxing packages to thousands of micro-influencers across a range of body types and skin tones, producing unedited fit videos that build trust faster than a polished ad could. Both tactics are cheap, repeatable, and aimed at an audience that already opted in, the opposite of the celebrity-cash-grab reputation the brand is often given credit for.

kept.heading: TIKTOK COMMENTS ARE GETTING MORE INTERACTIVE WITH VOICE COMMENTS, POLLS, AND MORE (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: The goal is comments people linger in and interact with, not just scroll past.

kept.heading: DUSTED (WEBSITE)
kept.blurb: A community-driven platform for marketers to show off their work beyond a resume.

kept.heading: SHOULD THERE BE AEO AGENCIES? (6 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Content was never the real value of SEO agencies. Growth was. Agencies made content the deliverable because it was easy to scope, and rankings made progress easy to measure. AI is now exposing the weakness of that model by making content cheap and easy to produce. Agencies need to shift from content production to strategic work that drives growth, rather than simply rebranding old SEO services as AEO.

kept.heading: WHAT DRIVES GEN Z BRAND LOYALTY IN 2026? (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: 64% of Gen Z say they stick with brands they like most or all of the time, but only 11% feel brands understand them really well. Feeling understood is strongly linked to loyalty, with 45% of those who feel truly understood saying they are always loyal. Price and value (82%) and product quality (80%) matter most, while influencer recommendations rank last at 9%. Relevance starts with understanding customers, but loyalty still depends on delivering a product worth coming back to.

kept.heading: HOW TO HANDLE NEGATIVE COMMENTS ON REDDIT (WHEN THE CRITICISM IS ALREADY RANKING) (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Treat negative Reddit posts as a community management issue, since high-ranking criticism can shape search results and AI answers. Respond selectively as a named, disclosed person by correcting misinformation or adding useful product context. Positive and negative threads receive similar upvote weight, so helpful brand contributions can reach audiences at a similar scale. Build credibility early by listening and using REACT to decide when to engage or step back.

kept.heading: YOUR PUBLIC BOOKING FORM IS A BOT MAGNET. HERE IS HOW TO SEAL IT (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Public forms can attract spam bots as soon as a product launches, especially without login requirements. The author recommends a two-layer system. Use Cloudflare Turnstile on every public form and verify its token server-side before storing submissions. A database trigger adds another safeguard by rejecting invalid submissions that bypass the application. Turnstile is free for up to 1M monthly requests, making it a low-cost way to protect public forms from spam.

kept.heading: BECOME A MARKETING ENGINEER (WEBINAR)
kept.blurb: Tim Keen will walk through when and how to use GitHub and Terminal, the new surfaces that marketers live in. Learn how to build a machine that builds marketing assets for you and manage Meta, Google, and LinkedIn ads from the terminal. This will take place on September 10 at 12 PM ET.

kept.heading: TIKTOK JUST MADE PAID SOCIAL AGENTIC (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: TikTok's new agentic AI tools can automate paid social execution, but the bigger shift is teaching AI how your team works. TikTok Ads MCP connects AI to campaign data and workflows, while Agentic Hub and Skills can package processes like creative fatigue analysis, budget optimization, reporting, and QA. Automate repeatable work, but keep humans involved in strategic decisions.

kept.heading: REDDIT MAX CAMPAIGNS ARE NOW AVAILABLE TO ALL ADVERTISERS (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Reddit is making Max campaigns available to all advertisers, alongside 3 updates designed to expand their value. Max campaigns automate targeting, creative selection, placements, and budget allocation, with early tests showing 17% lower CPA and 27% more conversions. New asset groups let advertisers organize and measure different products or use cases within one campaign, while API and Smartly support make campaigns easier to manage at scale.

kept.heading: GLOSSIER AND DISHOOM'S ROYA SHARIAT ON BUILDING BRANDS, FOLLOWING YOUR CURIOSITY, AND DESIGNING AN UNCONVENTIONAL CAREER (6 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Glossier used direct customer feedback to shape products, then expanded that customer-first approach into its brand positioning. Dishoom takes a similar approach to scaling, focusing on preserving the core experience rather than optimizing for growth alone. For new brand ideas, Roya recommends testing scrappy versions instead of waiting for a perfect strategy. She also uses data to pitch new ideas, pairing consumer insights with a clear business case.

kept.heading: GOOGLE'S LATEST STUDY REVEALS HOW LLMS RECALL FACTS (6 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Getting recalled correctly by AI models does not require more content - it requires making existing content easier to retrieve. Advanced models store 95% to 98% of the facts they are trained on but reliably recall only 26% to 34% of them. Recall breaks down most on facts asked backward from how they were learned, or on facts that are simply rare. Auditing where AI tools already mention or skip a brand's key facts shows exactly which messages need restating in both directions.

kept.heading: INFLUENCERS MOSTLY SKIP DISCLOSURE (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Brands can face penalties for undisclosed paid partnerships or free products.
